meta.processing: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 (Japan) and admin-0 (neighbours) simplified with Douglas-Peucker (0.0015 deg prefectures, 0.008 deg neighbours); islands >= 1e-06 deg² kept; interior rings (lakes) >= 2e-05 deg² kept; coordinates rounded to 3 decimals.
meta.note: Basemap only: land and administrative outlines for orientation. It carries no hazard, intensity or impact meaning. Natural Earth 1:10m is a generalised product (~1 km median offset against a 1:25,000 coastline). Islands that Natural Earth 1:10m does not carry — 16 islands of 5 km² and above in Kagoshima and Okinawa — come from 国土数値情報（行政区域）N03-2025 (data date 2025-01-01) and are simplified to the same tolerance; islets below 5 km² appear only where Natural Earth draws them. Not for navigation or measurement.
